hook: If you jumped off Miranda's cliff, you'd fall for minutes.
title: A Cliff Where Falling Takes Minutes
description:
Uranus's moon Miranda has a cliff called Verona Rupes, estimated at about 20 km tall. Miranda's gravity is so weak that a fall from the top would take many minutes. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #Uranus
comment_prompt: Would you jump? Yes or no
